facts.text: StandaRotatorManager drives a Standa-branded motor controller, for example 8SMC5 for a motorized rotation mount
The manager reads motorListIndex, ximcLibLocation, stepsPerTurn and microstepsPerStep from the rotator setup and constructs a StandaMotor with them
The manager's get_pos stores the value the motor reports in _position
The position property returns the manager's _position field
The manager's move_abs passes its argument to the motor's moveabs and refreshes the position
The manager's move_rel passes its argument to the motor's moverel and refreshes the position
The manager's set_zero_pos calls the motor's set_zero_pos and refreshes the position
The manager's stop_cont_rot calls the motor's stop_cont_rot
The widget documents the absolute position and the relative step of the rotation mount in degrees
The widget displays the rotation position in deg
StandaMotor.dist_translate converts an angle in degrees to steps and microsteps, and dist_translate_inv converts a reported step position back to degrees
The documentation defines stepsPerTurn as the full motor steps per 360 degrees and microstepsPerStep as the microstep subdivision
The manager's close calls the motor's close
